title: Strength
text:
Strength (or Str) is one of three attributes, along with Intelligence and Dexterity. Strength is required to equip most armour-granting armour, as well as most melee weapons, sceptres, and their associated skills. Characters gain +2 maximum life per strength.


== Base stats ==
Characters start with a certain amount of base strength based on their character class.

Pure strength character classes (Marauder and Warrior) start with 15 Strength.
Hybrid strength character classes (Templar, Druid, Duelist, and Mercenary) start with 11 Strength.
All other non-strength character classes start with 7 Strength.
Strength provides an inherent bonus of +2 maximum life per 1 strength.
